prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Name Recognition Hint: Add clear tip carousel components explaining how pet naming impacts in-app interaction. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9%, making it the largest single drop-off point in the onboarding funnel.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Account Recovery & Reset Warning Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy warning users to sign in with their existing account to prevent pet resets. (why: 8 support tickets cited missing or reset pets caused by logging in via alternate accounts.)
2: [finish, notification] Launch Completed Desktop Mascot Welcome: Display an interactive mascot welcome widget on the final home intro screen guiding the user to their desktop. (why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% with a long median completion time of 395s.)
3: [adoption, layout] Compact Pet Choice Selection Screen: Switch pet selection layout to a compact showcase separating pre-made and custom companions. (why: Adoption step has a long mean completion time of 1017s and 39.1% overall churn.)
